thesis.text: The US economy grew at a 3.4% annualised pace in Q3 2026, its fastest in a year. The IMF sees global growth rising from 3.1% this year to 3.4% in 2027.
S&P 500 earnings grew 31.4% year on year in Q3 2026, the third straight quarter above 25%, and 84% of companies beat estimates.
The S&P 500 trades at 17.7 times next year's earnings, below its 5-year (19.8) and 10-year (19.1) averages. Morgan Stanley moved to its most bullish rating on global stocks on 16 Nov.
